ticker_news.title: Top Analyst Says AMD's 2026 Success Depends On These 3 Factors— And It Doesn't 'Need To Beat' Nvidia
ticker_news.description: Shay Boloor, Chief Market Strategist at Futurum Equities, identifies three key factors for AMD's 2026 success: strong CPU growth as a cash engine, successful Helios platform deployment, and adoption by major customers like Microsoft, Meta, Oracle, and Tesla to avoid single-vendor AI infrastructure. AMD doesn't need to beat Nvidia but rather become part of default architecture. The analysis comes as Trump's 25% tariff on high-end AI chips impacts the sector, though AMD continues advancing in AI hardware.
ticker_news.author: Namrata Sen

ticker_news.title: How AMD Stock Beat the Market (and Nvidia) in 2025
ticker_news.description: AMD stock surged 77.3% in 2025, significantly outperforming the S&P 500's 16.4% gain and Nvidia's 38.9% return. The major catalyst was OpenAI's October announcement of a multi-year deal to purchase 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct AI accelerators, representing a $120 billion revenue opportunity over 5 years. The deal demonstrates AMD's competitive capability in high-end AI workloads and signals potential for other hyperscalers to adopt AMD chips.
ticker_news.author: Anders Bylund

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jones Futures Drop, Nasdaq 100 Gains As Tech Stocks Rebound— Goldman Sachs, Taiwan Semiconductor, ASML In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures rose on Thursday following Wednesday's decline, with tech stocks rebounding. Taiwan Semiconductor reported a 35% profit surge in Q4, while Applied Materials received an analyst upgrade. Goldman Sachs is set to report earnings. Tariff uncertainty and Supreme Court delays on framework legality continue to weigh on markets. The Fed is expected to hold rates steady in January.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
